massRename.title: Mass rename
massRename.scopeDetail: {label} · {count} file(s) · file names only, folders unchanged
massRename.general.summary: Only file names change; folders in the torrent layout are left as-is. The preview on the right highlights changes in orange. Review the list before Apply.
massRename.general.stemOnly: Stem only — the rule runs on the name without the extension; the extension is appended again afterward.
massRename.general.sort: Sort for {n} — counter order by full path or by file name.
massRename.help.findReplace.title: Find and replace
massRename.help.findReplace.summary: Finds a substring in the name (or in the stem when Stem only is on) and replaces it. An empty Find field changes nothing. Case insensitive when Case sensitive is off.
massRename.help.findReplace.examples: Find: 1080p → Replace: 720p,Find: .copy → Replace: (empty) — remove substring,Find: foo → Replace: bar in episode.foo.mkv → episode.bar.mkv
massRename.help.prefixSuffix.title: Prefix and suffix
massRename.help.prefixSuffix.summary: Adds text at the start and/or end of the current name. The rest of the name stays the same.
massRename.help.numbering.title: Numbering
massRename.help.numbering.summary: Builds each new name only from the template. Supports {n} and {n:02} (zero-padded). Start/Step set the first index and increment. The original name is not kept — use Template for "01 - old name".
massRename.help.numbering.examples: Template: {n:02} → 01, 02, 03…,Template: ep_{n:03} → ep_001, ep_002,Start: 5, Step: 2, template: {n} → 5, 7, 9…
massRename.help.regex.title: Regular expressions
massRename.help.regex.summary: The pattern matches the full filename including the extension (.mkv, etc.). Stem only does not apply. Use $1, $2, … in Replacement for groups. Flags: i — case insensitive, g — all matches. For digits use \d (one backslash in the field). Extension tail: .*mkv, not .*\.mkv.
massRename.help.regex.examples: (Show) (\d+).*mkv → $1 $2.mkv — title and episode number,^(\d+).* → ep_$1 — prefix a leading number,\s+ → _ — spaces to underscores
massRename.help.template.title: Template
massRename.help.template.summary: Defines the full new name from placeholders. {n} / {n:02} — counter using the selected sort; Start and Step come from the Numbering fields (shared). {name} — stem, {ext} — extension with dot, {basename} — name with extension, {path} — file path inside the torrent.
